The NIE isolates the portion of the total effect that operates via the mediator (blood pressure) while holding the treatment status (having a sister) constant at the reference level (no sister) for the outcome equation.

The formula for the NIE is:
$$NIE = E[Y(0, B(1))] - E[Y(0, B(0))]$$
